q: Why might a vision-language model misread small text in an image?
options: The image was processed at too low a resolution for the text to survive
explain: Resolution and patching decide what detail reaches the model.

q: What turns an image into something a language model can attend to?
options: Patches encoded by a vision encoder and projected into the model’s embedding space
explain: Image tokens sit beside text tokens.

q: Under Anthropic’s published rule (as of November 2026), about how many tokens is a 1,000 × 1,000 image?
What should you do with large screenshots when only one region matters?
options: Crop to the region so text stays readable and cost falls
explain: Downscaling can make small text unreadable.
